svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6.4 - Device Profile save, default switch, delete and runtime propagation

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6.4 - Device Profile save, default switch, delete and runtime propagation
log failure action with empty Profile id
An image resource may already be committed
while the Profile row was not saved.
fallback listener may create Edge event now
SELECT Devices by tenant and profileId
A mid-loop failure cannot roll back the committed Profile
or previously committed Device compatibility updates.
SELECT Devices by Profile and empty OTA
async OTA state telemetry / attribute work
The previous transaction is not rolled back.
The tenant may have no default Profile.
No onDeviceProfileChange and no lifecycle broadcast.
Transport and Rule Engine runtime caches are not refreshed for isDefault.
update matching SessionInfo and protocol adaptor
MQTT refreshes topic filters, payload type,
Protobuf descriptors and adaptor without reconnect.
No Profile listener callback is made for null.
Normal delete has no referencing Devices because of the FK.
There is no database outbox or shared transaction across Profile rows,
Transport/lifecycle/data queues, Session updates, OTA state and Audit.
